THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF JAMES KNIGHT IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHIME FINANCIAL INC, REPRESENTED BY ERICA CRANE IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. ISHA SRIVASTAVA, WHO ORIGINALLY FILED REQUEST FOR ZOOM APPEARANCE IS PRESENT ON ZOOM AS AN ATTENDEE (OBSERVING). COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. DEFENDANT MAKES A REQUEST FOR THIS MATTER TO BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. COURT DENIES DEFENDANT'S REQUEST. PLAINTIFF CLAIM IS STILL WITHIN HIS STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS. PLAINTTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS ARE RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
